rad: 1. About the DHL Express Global Customs Compliance Policy
• Provide specific feedback and support to countries based in the information assessed

• Develop training of how to document and update procedures.
• Ensure proper and timely communication of all relevant regulatory or process changes
• Develop additional tools to reinforce the country self-assessment process and support action plans.
• Collaborate with Global to develop a standard training plan for customs topics.

• Provide visibility of URL incidence in the Region
• Provide a regulatory analysis of the impact across the region, including fines and penalties.
